title: cucubalus noctiflorus
intro: Cucubalus noctiflorus, commonly known as Night-flowering Catchfly, is a flowering plant native to Europe, North Africa, and Western Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Night-flowering Catchfly include its ability to stimulate digestion, improve liver function, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
